verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop file converter, so the axis applies. The pack only says user files are not uploaded and the app works offline. It never mentions telemetry, usage analytics or any opt-out setting. File-content privacy is an adjacent claim, not a documented telemetry control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
